responsibility: Contains the core RTL machine description for CRIS instruction selection and low-level optimization. It defines register-number constants and unspec codes, instruction and delay-slot attributes, expanders, define_insn patterns, output templates, splits, and peephole2 transformations for CRIS arithmetic, branches, moves, compares, multi-register transfers, addressing-mode exploitation, and condition-code behavior, thereby translating generic RTL into CRIS assembly forms recognized by reload, scheduling, and final emission.
same_name_distinction: Unlike cris.cc, cris.h, and cris.opt, this file is the machine description proper: it gives CRIS register constants, attributes, define_insn/expander/split/peephole RTL patterns and output rules that drive instruction selection and scheduling, rather than C++ hook code, preprocessor target macros, or option metadata.
